title: SymRegFlow: Symmetry-Regularized Flow Matching for Video World Models
title_zh: SymRegFlow：基于对称性正则化的流匹配方法，用于视频世界模型

paragraphs.en: Flow-matching-based multi-view world models generate realistic videos, but are commonly restricted to fixed camera rigs. Extending them to continuously varying camera poses requires paired pose–video observations with dense pose coverage, which are costly to acquire. We introduce SymRegFlow , a symmetry-regularized flow-matching framework for multi-view-consistent video generation across continuous viewpoints without ground-truth novel-view RGB supervision. For each target pose, SymRegFlow geometrically warps source views into noisy anchors and combines masked dual-anchor supervision with cross-anchor denoising-output consistency to mitigate anchor-specific errors. Under an affine Gaussian surrogate, we prove that suitable consistency regularization recovers the clean-reference optimum at fixed noise levels, strictly outperforming single- and merged-anchor baselines. Experiments on Cosmos-Drive-Dreams and nuScenes demonstrate high-quality, multi-view-consistent autonomous-driving video generation: on nuScenes, SymRegFlow achieves the lowest FVD and FVMD among the evaluated baselines, reducing FVD by over 31% relative to the best baseline, and source-conditioned inference also attains the best FID and instance preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于流匹配的多元视角世界模型能够生成逼真的视频，但通常受限于固定的相机设备。 要将这些模型扩展到连续变化的相机姿态，需要具有密集姿态覆盖的成对姿态-视频观测数据，而这些数据的获取成本高昂。 我们提出了 SymRegFlow——一种对称性正则化的流匹配框架，能够在没有真实新视角 RGB 监督的情况下，生成跨连续视角的多视角一致视频。 对于每个目标姿态，SymRegFlow 会将源视角通过几何变换转换为含噪锚点，并结合掩码双锚点监督与跨锚点去噪输出一致性，以减轻特定锚点的误差。 在仿射高斯代理模型下，我们证明了合适的正则化一致性能够在固定噪声水平下恢复干净参考的最优解，其性能严格优于单锚点和合并锚点基线模型。 在 Cosmos-Drive-Dreams 和 nuScenes 上的实验表明，该框架能够生成高质量且多视角一致的汽车驾驶视频：在 nuScenes 数据集上，SymRegFlow 在评估的基线模型中实现了最低的 FVD 和 FVMD，与最佳基线相比，FVD 降低了超过 31%，并且基于源条件的推理也获得了最佳的 FID 和实例保留效果。

paragraphs.en: Video world models have become powerful generative simulators of dynamic environments. In autonomous driving, recent systems jointly synthesize the RGB streams of a surround-view camera rig, conditioned on maps, object layouts, and text ( Gao et al., 2024a ; Gao et al., 2024b ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ) . Joint multi-view learning can implicitly capture spatial consistency across views. We refer to the desired property as video SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) symmetry: under a rigid camera-pose change g ∈ SE ⁡ ( 3 ) g\in\mathrm{SE}(3) , the scene content and dynamics remain unchanged, while the generated RGB video transforms consistently with the induced reprojection on co-visible regions ( Dupont et al., 2020 ; Xu et al., 2022 ) . Because SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) is continuous, this consistency should extend across camera poses; current models, however, support only the finite viewpoints represented by their training rigs.

paragraphs.en: Continuous-view generation supports sensor simulation, closed-loop autonomy evaluation ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , training-data augmentation ( Tonderski et al., 2024 ) , and cinematographic camera control ( He et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025a ) . However, nuScenes and Waymo Open ( Caesar et al., 2020 ; Sun et al., 2020 ) provide synchronized videos only from fixed calibrated cameras, leaving intermediate viewpoints and novel camera heights or baselines without paired targets. ReCamMaster and SynCamMaster obtain synchronized multi-camera training videos from Unreal Engine ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Bai et al., 2025b ) , incurring high generation costs, a sim-to-real gap, and unmodeled simulator artifacts.

paragraphs.en: To avoid simulator-generated supervision, we use off-the-shelf 3D perception models to warp observed source views to sampled novel poses, producing noisy anchor videos affected by geometry errors, occlusions, and resampling. We introduce SymRegFlow , which combines masked dual-anchor supervision with cross-anchor denoising consistency under shared diffusion noise, while retaining observed-view supervision to preserve pretrained generative capabilities. This symmetry inductive bias reduces sensitivity to anchor-specific errors without requiring ground-truth novel-view videos.
paragraphs.zh: 为避免由模拟器生成的监督，我们使用现成的 3D 感知模型，将观测到的源视图变形至采样出的新姿态，从而生成受几何错误、遮挡和重采样影响的含噪锚点视频。 我们提出了 SymRegFlow，它将掩码双锚点监督与共享扩散噪声下的跨锚点去噪一致性相结合，同时保留对观测视图的监督，以维持预训练生成的能力。 这种对称性归纳偏置降低了对特定锚点错误的敏感度，而无需依赖新视角的真实视频数据。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate at the midpoint ( α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 ), a challenging interpolation pose that maximizes the distance to the nearest observed view (Sec. 2.3 ). Table 1 shows that both inference modes outperform all baselines in FVD and FVMD, indicating improved video quality and motion consistency. Joint-generated inference achieves the lowest FVD ( 158.62 158.62 ) and FVMD ( 2519.17 2519.17 ) and the highest VBench temporal-flickering score ( 96.25 96.25 ), with subject and background consistency close to OmniRe. Source-cond. inference improves FID from 22.00 22.00 to 19.22 19.22 , surpassing FreeVS ( 20.60 20.60 ), while retaining similar FVD ( 159.02 159.02 ) but yielding higher FVMD ( 2932.87 2932.87 ) and a lower temporal-flickering score ( 95.82 95.82 ). Source-cond. inference also achieves the highest instance-preservation score ( 99.44 99.44 ), which is critical for autonomous driving. Because joint-generated content can differ from dataset observations under the same scene conditioning (Fig. 3 ), its MEt3R ( 0.2818 0.2818 ) is computed against the generated existing views and measures internal cross-view agreement, whereas source-cond. MEt3R ( 0.2920 0.2920 ) measures agreement with captured views. The latter trails FreeVS ( 0.2829 0.2829 ), plausibly because our source conditioning relies on training-free latent replacement, whereas FreeVS injects reprojected source appearance through pseudo-images during training and inference ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Dual-anchor fine-tuning improves novel-view generation even without consistency regularization: C 0 C_{0} outperforms all three anchor baselines in novel-view FVD and both VBench consistency scores. paragraphs.en: To better expose the biases in A L A_{L} and A R A_{R} , we conduct a controlled one-scene experiment. Both models tend to copy anchor-visible content when inpainting missing regions, duplicating construction workers and background buildings and violating camera-pose symmetry. paragraphs.en: Generative models commonly preserve symmetric target distributions through equivariant score or velocity fields ( Köhler et al., 2020 ) . Equivariant diffusion uses an E ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{E}(3) -equivariant denoiser, while equivariant flow-matching methods constrain continuous normalizing-flow vector fields or probability paths ( Hoogeboom et al., 2022 ; Klein et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ) . Flow Equivariant World Models instead build motion-aligned equivariance into a structured latent memory ( Lillemark et al., 2026 ) . More generally, these methods require symmetry-specific denoisers, vector fields, or latent-memory architectures. Architecture-agnostic alternatives avoid such redesign but rely, respectively, on group-averaged training targets or symmetry-structured noise during training and sampling ( Tong et al., 2025 ; Liu and Vahdat, 2025 ) . SymRegFlow introduces a symmetry inductive bias through its fine-tuning objective, aligning denoising outputs induced by independently warped, noisy anchors over the union of valid anchor supports while retaining the underlying flow-matching formulation.
paragraphs.zh: 生成模型通常通过等变得分场或速度场来保留对称的目标分布（Köhler 等人，2020）。 等变扩散使用一个 E(3) 等变的去噪器，而等变流匹配方法则对连续的正则化流向量场或概率路径施加约束（Hoogeboom 等人，2022；Klein 等人，2023；Song 等人，2023）。 流等变世界模型则将运动对齐的等变性嵌入到结构化的潜在记忆中（Lillemark 等人，2026）。 更一般地，这些方法需要针对特定对称性设计的去噪器、向量场或潜在记忆架构。 与架构无关的替代方案避免了这种重新设计，但分别依赖在训练和采样期间使用群平均训练目标或具有对称性结构的噪声（Tong 等人，2025；Liu 和 Vahdat，2025）。 SymRegFlow 通过其微调目标引入了一种对称性归纳偏置，在保留底层流匹配公式的同时，将由独立扰动、带噪声的锚点所引发的去噪输出对齐到有效锚点支撑集的并集上。

paragraphs.en: Training-free methods keep a pretrained video generator frozen and enforce a target trajectory at inference through latent replacement, sampling-time guidance, or test-time optimization ( Hou and Chen, 2025 ; Park et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . They avoid paired training data but typically require modified sampling or trajectory-specific refinement. SymRegFlow instead learns camera control by fine-tuning and retains the standard sampler for arbitrary target poses; source-cond. inference additionally uses source-latent replacement.
paragraphs.zh: 无需训练的方法会保持预训练视频生成器处于冻结状态，并通过潜在空间替换、采样时引导或测试时优化（Hou 和 Chen, 2025；Park 等, 2026；Zhou 等, 2025；Wang 等, 2026）在推理阶段强制实现目标轨迹。 这些方法无需配对训练数据，但通常需要修改采样过程或针对特定轨迹进行优化。 相比之下，SymRegFlow 通过微调学习相机控制，并保留标准采样器以支持任意目标姿态；源条件推理还会额外使用源潜在空间替换。

paragraphs.en: MotionCtrl, CameraCtrl, 4DiM, and ReCamMaster amortize camera-controlled generation using costly pose-annotated or synchronized pose–video pairs, generally producing one target stream ( Wang et al., 2024b ; He et al., 2025 ; Watson et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025a ) . ReCapture ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) fits video-specific LoRAs to valid pixels of a noisy warped anchor for each requested trajectory, masking missing regions and relying on the pretrained prior to repair artifacts. It neither couples source-camera anchors nor enforces cross-view symmetry. SymRegFlow instead uses dataset-level fine-tuning and agreement among independently warped anchors to reduce view-specific errors.
paragraphs.zh: MotionCtrl、CameraCtrl、4DiM 和 ReCamMaster 利用昂贵的姿态标注数据或同步的姿态度对，将相机控制的生成过程摊销成本，通常只产生一个目标流（Wang et al., 2024b；He et al., 2025；Watson et al., 2025；Bai et al., 2025a）。 ReCapture（Zhang et al., 2025）为每条请求的轨迹，针对噪声干扰且经过形变的锚点图像中的有效像素，拟合视频特定的 LoRAs，同时掩码缺失区域并依赖预训练先验来修复伪影。 它既不对源相机锚点进行耦合，也不强制跨视角对称性。 相比之下，SymRegFlow 采用数据集级别的微调，并利用独立形变的锚点之间的相互一致性，来减少特定视角的错误。

paragraphs.en: Joint-view generators couple synchronized spatio-temporal camera tokens through self- or cross-view attention, conditioned on rig identities, maps, boxes, text, or actions. Examples include MagicDrive, Drive-WM, and DriveDreamer-2 for driving ( Gao et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) , and Cosmos-Predict/Transfer2.5 for driving and multi-camera robotics ( Ali et al., 2025 ) . Their cross-camera consistency remains tied to training-rig slots and poses. SymRegFlow introduces a continuously pose-conditioned target slot while preserving the pretrained multi-view prior, without novel-view RGB supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 联合视角生成器通过自注意力或跨视角注意力机制，将同步的空间-时间相机标记耦合在一起，其条件取决于设备身份、地图、框、文本或动作。 相关示例包括用于驾驶任务的 MagicDrive、Drive-WM 和 DriveDreamer-2（Gao 等人，2024a；Wang 等人，2024a；Zhao 等人，2025），以及用于驾驶和多相机机器人任务的 Cosmos-Predict/Transfer2.5（Ali 等人，2025）。 它们的跨相机一致性仍然与训练设备中的槽位和姿态相关联。 SymRegFlow 引入了一种持续受姿态条件约束的目标槽位，同时保留了预训练的多视角先验，且无需新视角的 RGB 监督。

paragraphs.en: SymRegFlow extends pretrained multi-view world models to cross-view-consistent video generation across continuous viewpoints without novel-view RGB supervision, combining masked dual-anchor supervision with cross-anchor denoising consistency to mitigate source-dependent biases. Under an affine Gaussian surrogate, suitable regularization recovers the clean-reference optimum at each noise level. On nuScenes, SymRegFlow achieves the lowest FVD and FVMD among evaluated baselines, with source-conditioned inference also attaining the best FID and instance preservation; ablations confirm improved novel-view quality and reduced source-dependent attention bias.
paragraphs.zh: SymRegFlow 将预训练的多视角世界模型扩展到跨视角一致的视频生成，可在连续视角间实现生成而无需新视角的 RGB 监督；它结合掩码双锚点监督与跨锚点去噪一致性，以减轻源依赖偏差。 在仿射高斯代理模型下，适当的正则化能在每个噪声水平上恢复出干净参考的最优解。 在 nuScenes 数据集上，SymRegFlow 在所有评估的基线模型中取得了最低的 FVD 和 FVMD；其源条件推理也实现了最佳的 FID 和实例保留效果；消融实验证实了该方法提升了新视角的质量，并减少了源依赖的注意力偏差。

paragraphs.en: SymRegFlow depends on anchor quality: depth, projection, and visibility errors can corrupt supervision, especially near occlusions or under large viewpoint changes. Dual-anchor consistency cannot correct shared systematic errors, and jointly unseen regions lack direct supervision. Better anchors and geometric-uncertainty modeling remain open directions.
paragraphs.zh: SymRegFlow 依赖于锚点的质量：深度、投影和可见性误差会破坏监督信号，尤其是在遮挡区域附近或视角发生较大变化时。 双锚点一致性无法纠正共享的系统性误差，且联合未观测到的区域缺乏直接监督。 改进锚点以及建立几何不确定性模型仍是待探索的研究方向。

paragraphs.en: SymRegFlow combines supervision from both noisy anchors with shared-noise consistency. Supervision alone fits the inflated anchor variance q + ν q+\nu ; consistency penalizes sensitivity to anchor disagreement and, at the calibrated strength, recovers the clean-reference optimum. Stronger regularization further shrinks the denoiser’s slope below the clean optimum, increasing excess risk. Zero excess risk means attaining the minimum total risk q / D ⁡ ( t ) q/D(t) , not zero reconstruction error. The comparison concerns clean-reference evaluation, not the numerical values of different training objectives. It holds for the stated affine, independent-error surrogate with unit masks and fixed source predictions; it does not assert the same guarantee for the full neural network or one constant λ c \lambda_{c} across all diffusion times.
paragraphs.zh: SymRegFlow 结合了来自噪声锚点的监督与共享噪声一致性。 仅靠监督会拟合膨胀的锚点方差 q + ν q+\nu；而一致性则惩罚对锚点差异的敏感性，并在经过校准的强度下恢复干净参考的最优解。 更强的正则化会进一步将去噪器的斜率压缩到干净最优解以下，从而增加超额风险。 零超额风险意味着达到最小总风险 q / D ⁡ ( t ) q/D(t)，而非重建误差为零。 该比较针对的是干净参考评估，而非不同训练目标的数值。 这一结论适用于所述具有单位掩码和固定源预测的仿射、独立误差代理模型；但它并未对完整的神经网络或所有扩散时间下统一的常数 λ c \lambda_{c} 提供同样的保证。

paragraphs.en: Cosmos-Transfer2.5 ( Ali et al., 2025 ) conditions each view on a world-scenario video composed of projected lane/map polylines and 3D object bounding boxes, rather than captured RGB footage, to specify scene layout and viewpoint. During training, we render this representation at the novel camera poses and feed its encoded latents into SymRegFlow through the backbone’s control branch. Both Cosmos-Drive-Dreams ( Ren et al., 2025a ) and nuScenes ( Caesar et al., 2020 ) provide the map annotations, object geometry, and camera calibration required for this rendering.
paragraphs.zh: Cosmos-Transfer2.5（Ali 等，2025）将每个视图的条件设定为一个由投影的车道/地图多段线和 3D 对象边界框组成的世界场景视频，而非采集的 RGB 影像，以此明确场景布局和视角。 在训练过程中，我们在新的相机姿态下渲染这种表示，并通过主干网络的控制分支将其编码后的潜在特征输入到 SymRegFlow 中。 Cosmos-Drive-Dreams（Ren 等，2025a）和 nuScenes（Caesar 等，2020）都提供了这种渲染所需的地图标注、对象几何信息和相机校准数据。

paragraphs.en: To minimize modifications to the pretrained backbone, we retain its integer-indexed embeddings for existing rig cameras. Our autonomous-driving data synthesis setting requires novel views interpolated along the six-camera ring. We therefore parameterize the continuous view embedder by the endpoint camera identities and a scalar ring coordinate, with additional geometric conditioning supplied by the world-scenario renderings. The pretrained camera embeddings remain frozen; Fourier features of the global ring coordinate drive a zero-initialized, endpoint-vanishing MLP residual added to the linearly interpolated embeddings ( α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 at the midpoint; Sec. C.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为尽可能减少对预训练主干网络的修改，我们保留了现有刚性摄像机的整数索引嵌入。 我们的自动驾驶数据合成设置需要沿六摄像头环进行插值的新视角。 因此，我们通过端点摄像机的身份标识和一个标量环坐标来参数化连续视角嵌入器，并由世界场景渲染提供额外的几何条件约束。 预训练的摄像机嵌入保持冻结；全局环坐标的傅里叶特征驱动一个零初始化、在端点处消失的多层感知机残差，并将其加到线性插值的嵌入中（在中点处 α = 0.5；参见第 C.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 pools outputs from eight scene-group adapters covering 30 nuScenes scenes, with six midpoint camera pairs per scene and frames 0–115 at 10 fps. FVD uses 720 nonoverlapping 29-frame clips per distribution, starting at frames 0, 29, 58, and 87; FID pools their 20,880 frames per distribution. VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) evaluates the 720 generated clips independently, using all 29 frames of each clip. FVMD ( Liu et al., 2024 ) uses 180 sequences of 116 frames at 10 fps per distribution for all six methods. Our sequences concatenate four independently generated 29-frame clips; baselines retain the first 116 frames of each released video. We bilinearly resize frames to 256 × 256 256\times 256 and use PIPS2 to track 400 points with 16 iterations per 16-frame window. A stride of one frame yields 18,180 windows per distribution, including windows crossing generation joins. We concatenate each window’s velocity and acceleration histograms and compute a single Fréchet distance between the generated novel-view and unpaired captured-source feature distributions, pooling all windows across scenes. Instance preservation (IP) ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) uses these same 180 116-frame sequences per model and the official fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct entity-anomaly detector. Each sequence is split into overlapping 2-second clips with a 1-second stride, retaining all 20 frames per clip. Following the official duration rule, the ten clips start at seconds 0–9 and cover frames 0–109, including all three generation joins; the final six frames are omitted. A sequence scores one only if every clip is classified as free of unnatural entity merging, duplication, or disappearance, and zero otherwise. We report 100 times the mean over all 180 sequences, with higher scores indicating better preservation. MEt3R compares novel views with synchronized existing-view videos: generated videos for the joint-generated result ( † ) and captured videos for all other rows. These settings measure internal cross-view consistency and agreement with observations, respectively. Each uses 41,760 candidate frame pairs per model, averaging its valid subset.
paragraphs.zh: 表1汇集了来自八个场景组适配器的输出，这些适配器覆盖了30个nuScenes场景，每个场景包含六个中间点摄像头对以及以10帧/秒速率采集的第0至115帧。 FVD在每个分布中使用720个互不重叠的29帧片段，分别始于第0、29、58和87帧；FID则汇总每个分布中的20,880帧。 VBench（Huang等，2024）独立评估这720个生成的片段，并使用每个片段的全部29帧。 FVMD（Liu等，2024）在所有六种方法中，每个分布使用180个包含116帧（10帧/秒）的序列。 我们的序列将四个独立生成的29帧片段拼接在一起；基线方法则保留每个已发布视频的前116帧。 我们将各帧通过双线性插值缩放至256×256，并使用PIPS2在每16帧的窗口内以16次迭代跟踪400个点。 以1帧为步长时，每个分布会产生18,180个窗口，包括跨越生成衔接处的窗口。 我们将每个窗口的速度和加速度直方图拼接起来，并计算生成的新视角特征分布与未配对的捕获源特征分布之间的单个Fréchet距离，同时汇总所有场景中的窗口。 实例保留性（IP）（Zheng等，2025）使用相同的每模型180个116帧序列，以及官方微调的Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct实体异常检测器。 每个序列被分割为重叠的2秒片段，步长为1秒，且保留每个片段的全部20帧。 根据官方时长规则，十个片段始于第0至9秒，覆盖第0至109帧，包括所有三个生成衔接处；最后六帧被省略。 仅当每个片段都被判定为不存在非自然的实体合并、重复或消失时，该序列才能获得1分；否则得分为0。 我们报告所有180个序列均值乘以100的结果，分数越高表示保留性越好。 MEt3R将新视角与同步的现有视角视频进行比较：联合生成的结果（†）使用生成的视频，而其他所有行均使用捕获的视频。 这些设置分别用于衡量内部跨视角一致性以及与观察结果的一致性。 每种方法每模型使用41,760个候选帧对，并计算其有效子集的平均值。

sents.zh: 我们将各帧通过双线性插值缩放至256×256，并使用PIPS2在每16帧的窗口内以16次迭代跟踪400个点。

sents.en: A stride of one frame yields 18,180 windows per distribution, including windows crossing generation joins.
sents.zh: 以1帧为步长时，每个分布会产生18,180个窗口，包括跨越生成衔接处的窗口。

sents.en: We concatenate each window’s velocity and acceleration histograms and compute a single Fréchet distance between the generated novel-view and unpaired captured-source feature distributions, pooling all windows across scenes.
sents.zh: 我们将每个窗口的速度和加速度直方图拼接起来，并计算生成的新视角特征分布与未配对的捕获源特征分布之间的单个Fréchet距离，同时汇总所有场景中的窗口。

sents.en: Instance preservation (IP) ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) uses these same 180 116-frame sequences per model and the official fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct entity-anomaly detector.

sents.en: Each sequence is split into overlapping 2-second clips with a 1-second stride, retaining all 20 frames per clip.

sents.en: Following the official duration rule, the ten clips start at seconds 0–9 and cover frames 0–109, including all three generation joins; the final six frames are omitted.

sents.en: A sequence scores one only if every clip is classified as free of unnatural entity merging, duplication, or disappearance, and zero otherwise.
sents.zh: 仅当每个片段都被判定为不存在非自然的实体合并、重复或消失时，该序列才能获得1分；否则得分为0。

sents.en: We report 100 times the mean over all 180 sequences, with higher scores indicating better preservation.
sents.zh: 我们报告所有180个序列均值乘以100的结果，分数越高表示保留性越好。

sents.en: MEt3R compares novel views with synchronized existing-view videos: generated videos for the joint-generated result ( † ) and captured videos for all other rows.

paragraphs.en: On one NVIDIA RTX 5880 Ada GPU, we compare backbone costs using 28 DiT blocks, width 2,048, 16 heads, rank-96 LoRA, BF16, batch size two, and activation checkpointing at every block. Randomly initialized models receive 8 × 16 × 16 8\times 16\times 16 tokens per view and retain both anchor branches until backward. DCVA shares source-view computation, whereas full attention recomputes it for each anchor. After one warm-up iteration, medians over three forward/backward runs are 3.07 3.07 and 4.51 4.51 seconds, respectively ( 1.47 × 1.47\times ). This reduced-resolution probe excludes the control network, VAE, rotary embeddings, data loading, optimizer, and distributed communication; it is not an end-to-end training benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 在一块 NVIDIA RTX 5880 Ada GPU 上，我们使用 28 个 DiT 块、宽度 2,048、16 个头、秩为 96 的 LoRA、BF16、批量大小为 2 以及每个块的激活检查点技术，来比较骨干网络的成本。 随机初始化的模型每视图接收 8 × 16 × 16 个 token，并在反向传播前保留两个锚分支。 DCVA 共享源视图的计算，而完整注意力机制则针对每个锚重新计算该部分。 经过一次预热迭代后，三次正向/反向运行中的中位数分别为 3.07 秒和 4.51 秒（1.47 倍）。 这个低分辨率探针不包含控制网络、VAE、旋转嵌入、数据加载器、优化器和分布式通信；它不是一个端到端的训练基准。
